notes.title: Suspended Development Notice
notes.notes:
Hello everyone,

It has been a really long time since I posted anything on this page, and by the look of it, I kind of abandoned the game. So I made this blog to tell you guys about the game and its future.

First of all, I would like to apologize to everyone for the radio silence. The reason is that I had been working on another game the entire time.

This game is like a learning experience for me, and as you can see, it’s bad. Now that I have the time to look back, I feel embarrassed about this game, even as the creator. There are so many things that could be made better in this game. But also, thanks to this game, I have learned many lessons that have helped me tremendously when I’m creating other games.

As for the current state of the game, it is severely lacking in both visual and gameplay aspects. And to fix this, I would need to rework the game from the ground, which requires a lot of time for one person. That’s why I decided to suspend development and focus solely on the other game.

Then what about the future of the game? It will be a very long time until I pick up this game again, probably 4-5 more years or even longer; you never know the future. But one thing is certain: I will not abandon the game. This game holds a lot of memories, and I don’t want to see it rot in the corner of Steam’s algorithm.

Then why do I tell you guys all of this? I could just ignore this and move on. Well, that’s because of how I live; once I start something, I will always finish it, no matter how long it takes.
And finally, my sincere thank you to those who have brought the game; your support has helped me tremendously in those hard times.

Now I will say the word: [b]The game "Our Little Chase" will now be in suspended development[/b]. As such, I don’t recommend buying the game in its current state. You can buy it if you want, but it’s going to be a very long time before you can see any kind of update.

Thank you all for your support,
aa11.
